deltas.before: 先过光心作平行于 $SB$ 的副光轴 $PQ$，再作通过焦点 $F$、垂直于主光轴的焦平面，求出它与副光轴的交点 $C$。
deltas.after: 先过光心作平行于 $SB$ 的副光轴 $PQ$，再在透镜的出射光一侧作通过像方焦点 $F$、垂直于主光轴的焦平面，求出它与副光轴的交点 $C$。

deltas.before: Draw the secondary optical axis $PQ$ through the optical center, parallel to $SB$, and draw the focal plane through the focus $F$, perpendicular to the principal axis; let its intersection with the secondary axis be $C$.
deltas.after: Draw the secondary optical axis $PQ$ through the optical center, parallel to $SB$; on the outgoing-light side of the lens, draw the focal plane through the image-side focus $F$, perpendicular to the principal axis, and let its intersection with the secondary axis be $C$.
